payload.title: Push notifications completeness: Web Push public surface, encrypted payloads, key rotation
payload.description:
APNs + FCM are exported/documented; Web Push and rotation are incomplete.

- Web Push adapter validates PushSubscription JSON but isn't exported via @frick/server, and `frick tenants set-push` doesn't write VAPID creds (push-adapters.md:13; status.md:81-83).
- Web Push deliberately sends an empty body — encrypted Web Push payloads (AES-128-GCM envelope) are follow-up (push-adapters.md:62).
- Push credential rotation requires re-saving every tenant's creds; no multi-key overlap/decryption window (push-adapters.md:77).

Target: documented Web Push adapter + CLI provisioning, encrypted payloads, zero-downtime multi-key rotation.
